quest.title: The Nameless Tomb
quest.description: There is a rumor floating around about a strange, nameless tomb, whose origins seem to be completely lost.

node.journal_entry: In the bustle of the city, the Agonian could hear rumors of lost cities, hidden treasures and adventures to be had out in the wilderness. What caught his attention most though was the rumor of a nameless tomb in the Mercian lands. The only thing certain is that it is place filled with ancient riches, but ancient evil as well.
The Agonian found the Tomb near the Qattenhal area.
